goal: Independently QA the WP-040 Phase 4B v2 playable-art integration for scope, import stability, runtime correctness, gameplay state transitions, visual hierarchy, silhouette separation, background-layer discipline, and readiness for BK play/feel review.
forbidden_changes: final BK/Human Creative Owner play-feel approval
final art direction or production asset approval

verify.name: Implementation contract and Run validate
verify.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/active/WP-2026W28-040.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260711-001.json

verify.name: Approved art references and status are correct
verify.command: for asset in background_world_layer_v2 player_avatar_v2 goal_marker_v2 hazard_marker_v2 collectible_item_v2 safe_platform_tile_v2 ui_status_panel_v2; do test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png" && test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png.import" && rg -q "res://assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png" game/scenes/main.tscn; done && jq -e '.production_approved == false and (.assets | all(.production_approved == false and .owner_review_status == "approved_for_prototype_integration_planning"))' art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art_v2/manifest.json

verify.name: Godot import, smoke, and headless runtime are clean
verify.command: godot --headless --path game --import && bash -lc 'out=$(scripts/smoke_test.sh 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR:" <<< "$out"' && bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

verify.name: Scene hierarchy and crop contract pass
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s = Path('game/scenes/main.tscn').read_text()
assert s.count('name="BackgroundWorldLayer"') == 1
assert 'SectionOneBackdrop' not in s and 'SectionTwoBackdrop' not in s
for node in ['GroundCollision','WarmupStepCollision','PlatformCollision','HazardCollision','CollectibleCollision','GoalCollision','PlayerCollision','Camera2D','RetryButton']:
    assert node in s, node
for atlas in ['AtlasTexture_player','AtlasTexture_ground_tile','AtlasTexture_collectible','AtlasTexture_hazard','AtlasTexture_goal','AtlasTexture_ui_panel']:
    assert atlas in s, atlas
print('scene hierarchy and crop contract ok')
PY

human_decision_reason: QA can prove scope, import, runtime, state-transition, and static readability readiness, but Phase 4B play/feel still requires BK/Human Creative Owner direct play judgment.
acceptance_criteria: QA creates only WP-041, RV-20260711-001, and RUN-20260711-002 and does not modify implementation files under review.
WP-040 and its Run validate and provide traceable implementation evidence.
All seven approved v2 assets exist, import, are referenced by the scene, and remain production_approved=false.
The scene has one coherent BackgroundWorldLayer and no v1 direct-art reference or split background node.
Player, goal, hazard, item, platform, HUD, and background preserve the approved visual hierarchy and silhouette-first separation at the configured scene scale.
Godot import, smoke, and clean headless scene runtime pass.
Automated runtime QA covers goal-before-item gating, item collection, goal success, retry/reset, hazard failure, and timer failure.
Existing collision and gameplay nodes remain explicit, and game/scripts/player.gd is unchanged by WP-040.
QA records any implementation or readability defect as an actionable issue rather than self-repairing it.
QA pass does not replace BK direct play/feel approval or promote production usage.
notes: WP-041 begins only after WP-040 implementation is frozen. Temporary QA scripts and screenshots may live under /tmp and are not repository artifacts.
